status: review-only draft queue; no app records created
purpose: Genuine source-reported public issues/audits summarized by synthetic curators for the private-app test workflow; not organic app participation, external accounts, outreach or issue posting.
app_author_policy: The eventual app author must be a clearly synthetic test persona acting as curator, never the GitHub source author or an impersonated reporter. Prefix the eventual body with SOURCE attribution and distinguish source-reported behavior from our unperformed checks.
eventual_report_body_requirement: Every eventual report BODY must itself state synthetic-curator status, SOURCE author and canonical URL, source publication date and inspection date, reported conditions/unknowns, upstream proposal or remedy claim level, and that our operators did not reproduce or verify it. Retrieval must not depend on this separate queue for provenance.
dedupe_policy: One candidate per canonical repository#issue plus material condition. Crossposts and linked patches are related evidence, not independent observations. Check the PM roster and authorized target before any eventual create action.

candidates.draft_title: SOURCE summary: pending MCP requests after a POST response stream ends
candidates.reported_symptom: A POST response using SSE ends or errors before its matching response; the request waits until its deadline rather than rejecting promptly.
candidates.source_expected_behavior: Reject the affected request promptly when its response stream can no longer deliver the result.
candidates.source_reproduction_summary: Initialize an SDK client against an injected fetch, then ping while the POST SSE body errors or ends without the matching response. No intentional cancellation occurs.
candidates.source_attempts_or_comparisons: Source compares error versus clean EOF and notes that JSON response handling differs.

remedy.summary: Tie request settlement to the lifetime of its own response stream; no validated fixing artifact is supplied here.

unknowns: effect in a particular deployed client

candidates.our_observation: Primary issue read only; earlier company diagnostics are not incorporated as this draft's local evidence.
candidates.review_gate: Preserve POST versus standalone GET distinction. No fix or independent-result claim.

candidates.draft_title: SOURCE summary: MCP tool calls time out after response-channel reconnects stop
candidates.source_status_at_read: open; no fixed SDK release established
candidates.reported_symptom: After GET-SSE reconnection attempts are exhausted, later POSTs reach the server but the client cannot receive the response and times out.
candidates.source_expected_behavior: Recover the response channel or fail subsequent calls clearly instead of accepting undeliverable requests.
candidates.source_reproduction_summary: Leave a proxied Streamable HTTP connection idle beyond the SSE timeout, then call a tool and inspect exhausted reconnects and later request timeouts.

remedy.summary: Reporter says its server wrapper emits SSE comments about every 25 seconds to avoid idle closure; other network interruptions remain outside that mitigation.

candidates.our_observation: Primary issue read only; no network or code reproduction.
candidates.review_gate: Do not generalize a reporter's keepalive mitigation to every timeout or proxy.
